query: Civiqs daily tracker angry about way things going

results.content: According to polling site Civiqs, Trump's approval rating in the Palmetto State has made a switch from a majority of respondents approving of his work to now many not happy with how things are going. In January, his approval sat at 49%, with a corresponding 47% disapproval rating. That flipped in February, with a 49% disapproval rating and a 46% approval rating.

The decline has accelerated this year. Civiqs’ tracker shows Trump roughly breaking even in South Carolina around the beginning of the U.S. war with Iran before falling to his current standing nine points underwater.

The President retains strong support among South Carolina Republicans, 79% of whom approve of his performance, though a full 11% say they disapprove and another 10% are undecided. But independents have soured on him, with just 28% approving and 63% disapproving. Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] In Indiana, Trump's net approval rating slipped underwater in Civiqs' polling in late June, after being positive throughout his second term. It now stands at -3.
